correctness.rationale: Complete canonical scalar normalization gives (5^10-1)/4 = 2441406 forms. Two independently implemented exact finite-field algorithms (gradient incidence and first-order line-restriction coefficient) give identical all-coverage histograms and the sharp maximum 29 with 186000 forms. Matrix-generated full PGL3(F5) action gives precisely two disjoint 93000-form orbits, and their union exhausts all 186000 maxima. Direct derivative contradictions and separate exact Groebner-chart computations show both representatives smooth over the algebraic closure. Reproducible code and outputs were replayed from the actual package.

value.rationale: This is a natural sharp quantitative question at the smallest prime field where cubics have already been excluded from complete tangent coverage. The result determines not merely that complete covering fails, but the exact two-point deficit and all equality types, with a rigid classification into precisely two geometrically smooth elliptic projective orbits of different arithmetic point counts. Such a classification gives the precise finite-field boundary of degree-three near tangent-filling and provides an exact benchmark for dual blocking phenomena; it is not a routine restatement of the earlier no-filling assertion.
